pkgmetadata.longdescription:
MouseVPN carries IPv4 through an authenticated encrypted UDP tunnel with Noise IK, X25519 and ChaCha20-Poly1305, and supports several independently revocable device keys. This package builds the Linux terminal client, the loopback SOCKS5 proxy client, the profile tool and optionally the Tauri desktop client and the multi-device server.
MouseVPN is an early MVP. It has not received an independent security audit and must not be presented as anonymous, unblockable or production-hardened software.

use.flag: Install the terminal client and the loopback SOCKS5 proxy client
Install the Tauri desktop client (pulls in net-libs/webkit-gtk)
Install the multi-device TUN/NAT server and the device provisioning tool
